narrative.overview: Cool gray canvas, Google Sans, tappable LIRR route map, white floating bottom sheet, black outline icons, blue primary action, floating navigation.
keyCharacteristics: Single app surface for the ride
rules: Steel #8e98a8 is only for compass ticks, hairlines, and a 2px mark on the catalog retry alert.
Brass #8f6b3d is only the compass needle.
No gears, smoke, sepia, rivet frames, or ornate borders.
dos: Lead route selection with tappable MTA geometry and a collapsible bottom sheet.
Keep simulated aim labeled, and name a missing sourced target instead of blaming sensors.
donts: Do not reintroduce the green design.
Do not use brass on buttons, navigation, sheets, text, or a second accent moment.
